# Annalise Cook — Graphic & Web Designer

> Annalise Cook is a graphic and web designer specializing in brand identity, website design, visual communication and social media marketing. She holds a BFA in Graphic Design from High Point University and works as a Graphic & Web Designer at Develomark.

## About
- [About & contact](https://annalisecook.com/about/): background, awards, tools, brands and recommendations
- Awards: Outstanding Body of Work Award in Graphic Design, High Point University (2025–2026); Creative Quarterly 83 Winner
- Tools: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Figma, Canva, Duda, Framer, WordPress
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/annalisec · https://www.instagram.com/annalisecdesign/ · https://www.linkedin.com/in/annalisec/
